triplets.head: Walt Disney Pictures
triplets.tail: Sweeping nighttime flyover of a magical kingdom (river, train, Matterhorn, Pride Rock, Tangled lanterns) culminating at the Cinderella/Sleeping Beauty Castle, where a glowing arc (representing Tinker Bell) sweeps over it and 'Disney' appears below, accompanied by 'When You Wish Upon a Star' from Pinocchio, composed by Christophe Beck

triplets.head: Walt Disney Animation Studios
triplets.tail: Films appear under the Walt Disney Pictures castle logo, followed by a text card reading 'Walt Disney Animation Studios' presented in various stylized forms

triplets.head: Pixar Animation Studios
triplets.tail: The Luxo Jr. lamp sequence — a playful desk lamp (from Pixar's 1986 short film Luxo Jr.) hops into frame, bounces on the letter 'I' in 'PIXAR' and squashes it flat, then looks at the camera and shines its light at the audience

triplets.head: Marvel Studios
triplets.tail: The 'Flipbook'/'World of the MCU' sequence — red-filtered comic book panels flip rapidly like a flipbook, transitioning into 3D-rendered footage of iconic MCU characters projected onto the letters of 'MARVEL' carved in a silver/chrome rectangle, with 'STUDIOS' appearing below, accompanied by a dramatic orchestral fanfare

triplets.head: Lucasfilm
triplets.tail: The 'Metallic Shining' logo (2015–present) — 'LUCASFILM' in chrome/silver metallic text with a dynamic pale-green shimmering/moving light effect flowing inside the letters, set against a black background, typically silent

triplets.head: 20th Century Studios
triplets.tail: The 'Monument' logo — a towering, three-dimensional Art Deco monolith bearing '20th CENTURY STUDIOS' surrounded by Art Deco buildings, illuminated by sweeping animated searchlights against a nighttime sky with the Los Angeles skyline, accompanied by the iconic fanfare originally composed by Alfred Newman in 1933, current version (2020–) animated by Picturemill

triplets.head: Searchlight Pictures
triplets.tail: Camera pans across a CGI Los Angeles cityscape at dusk, past searchlights that activate sequentially, structure reads 'SEARCHLIGHT PICTURES' with 'SEARCHLIGHT' large in the center, the rightmost searchlight floods the screen with light before cutting to black, accompanied by the Alfred Newman fanfare, current version (2020–) animated by MOCEAN and Blue Sky Studios

triplets.head: Disneynature
triplets.tail: An aurora illuminates a dark sky revealing the silhouette of the Cinderella/Sleeping Beauty Castle carved into a glacial iceberg with floating icebergs in the foreground, daylight fills the scene, a lens flare wipes in the forest-green text 'DiSNEYnature', accompanied by wind chimes, chanting, and a woodwind/string fanfare composed by Mark Mancina
